critical_code_review_comments: UserStreamingApp.jsx is now 6942 lines (grew from 6850). This is well beyond the 700-line maintainability threshold. Strongly recommend extracting AudioAdOverlay, MiniPlayer, FullPlayer, AlbumView, ArtistCard into /app/frontend/src/components/streaming/ files.

Duplicate MediaSession action handler setup in useAudioPlayer.js: first block at lines 879-953 (setup ONCE on mount) and second block at lines 1149-1165 (re-registers on nextSong/prevSong changes). The second block overwrites the first block's handlers on every nextSong/prevSong callback change, wasting re-registrations. Consider consolidating into the ref-based handler block only.

AudioAdOverlay useEffect deps include [ad, settings, onComplete] but onComplete is a useCallback that could change identity - if parent re-renders cause onComplete to change reference, the effect will re-run mid-ad playback and start a new audio instance. Consider using a ref for onComplete or an empty dep array with refs.

Lock screen fix via isTransitioningRef is correct but note: if setupAudioSource onReady fires after a user pauses manually (rare race), the ref reset could accidentally re-enable isPlaying via next play event. Low risk but worth a comment.

Lock screen autoplay fix CANNOT be end-to-end tested via Playwright (requires real browser tab visibility change + mobile lock screen). Code path verified via static review only. Recommend manual QA on real iPhone/Android web browsers.
